description: Edit the caption and/or media of a DRAFT (created in the Flomixy app or through the API) or of a post created through the API that is not yet published, and/or set or change the first comment (and its delay) and, on THREADS targets, the topicTag (null removes it) of individual existing targets via targets. Scheduled or published posts created in the app are refused (403), published posts cannot be edited (409) and a published first comment is locked. Needs the POSTS_WRITE scope and a member allowed to edit posts (posts:edit). On a WORDPRESS target the article fields (title, contentHtml/contentMarkdown, excerpt, slug, categories, tags, wpStatus, featuredImage, featuredImageAlt) can be edited the same way, only the ones you send change; once the article is published, any such edit is refused (409). Approval and the set of targets cannot be changed. Optional recyclingEnabled (+ recyclingIntervalDays/MaxRepeats/ExpiresAt) toggles Evergreen recycling and, unlike caption/media, works on an already-published post; requires the POSTS_RECYCLE scope.

caption.description: New caption. The limit depends on the targeted networks.

recyclingEnabled.description: Evergreen: toggle re-drafting this post every recyclingIntervalDays once (or after) it is PUBLISHED. Unlike caption/media, this can be set on an already-published post. Requires an API key with the POSTS_RECYCLE scope (403 otherwise).

recyclingExpiresAt.description: Stop recycling after this instant (ISO 8601 with time zone); must be in the future. Omit for never.

recyclingIntervalDays.description: Days between recycles. Required when enabling and the post has no interval stored yet.

recyclingMaxRepeats.description: Stop recycling after this many re-drafts. Omit for unlimited.

targets.description: Existing targets whose first comment to set/update (per-target firstComment / firstCommentDelayMinutes), or whose WORDPRESS article fields (title, contentMarkdown, featuredImage, ...) to edit.

accountId.description: Account id, needed only when the post has several targets on this channel.

categories.description: WORDPRESS only: category ids or names (max 50). Names must exist on the site (see list_wordpress_categories); an unknown name fails with CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND and the list of existing ones.

channel.description: Channel of an EXISTING target of this post (UPPERCASE canonical, lowercase accepted).

contentHtml.description: WORDPRESS only: article body as HTML (max 512 KB; sanitized on save). Use this OR contentMarkdown. REQUIRED (one of them) for a WORDPRESS target.

contentMarkdown.description: WORDPRESS only: article body as Markdown, converted to HTML here (raw HTML inside it is escaped, not passed through). Use this OR contentHtml.

excerpt.description: WORDPRESS only: short summary shown in blog listings, max 1000 characters.

featuredImage.description: WORDPRESS only: featured image URL (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF; video and SVG are rejected).

featuredImageAlt.description: WORDPRESS only: alt text of the featured image, max 500 characters.

firstComment.description: Set or change this network's first comment. Only while it is still scheduled; a published one is locked (409). Links in Instagram and Facebook comments are NOT clickable: on FACEBOOK put the link (e.g. the blog URL) in the caption itself, on its own last line, and do not use firstComment for a link; on INSTAGRAM use "link in bio". Threads comments keep clickable links.

firstCommentDelayMinutes.description: Minutes after publish before the comment is posted.

slug.description: WORDPRESS only: URL slug, normalised to lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (max 200).

tags.description: WORDPRESS only: tag ids or names (max 50). Names must exist on the site (see list_wordpress_categories with search); an unknown name fails with TAG_NOT_FOUND.

title.description: WORDPRESS only: article title, max 200 characters. REQUIRED for a WORDPRESS target.

topicTag.description: THREADS target only: set or change the topic tag (community); null removes it. 1-50 characters, no "." and no "&" (core-api rejects a bad tag with 422 and changes nothing). Only while the post is not published (409).

wpStatus.description: WORDPRESS only: status of the article on the site once it is published; "draft" leaves it unpublished there for the site editor.

name: update_post
title: Update post
